audience.text: C++ developers building desktop or server applications that need to generate, read, or modify Excel .xlsx spreadsheets without external runtime dependencies.

capabilities.text: Construct blank workbooks or load existing ones from file paths or in-memory streams, then save back to .xlsx format using Workbook.Save().
capabilities.title: Create and save .xlsx workbooks

capabilities.text: Set cell values with PutValue() accepting strings, integers, doubles, bools, and DateTime; retrieve values via GetValue(); and manage formulas with SetFormula()/GetFormula().
capabilities.title: Read and write cell values and formulas

capabilities.text: Modify cell styles including font properties, fill patterns, foreground/background colors, borders, alignment, and number formats via Style and Font objects.
capabilities.title: Apply cell and range formatting

capabilities.text: Control visibility, zoom, gridlines, headers, right-to-left layout, protection, auto-filtering, hyperlinks, defined names, and page setup through dedicated worksheet-level APIs.
capabilities.title: Manage worksheet features

capabilities.text: Apply rule-driven formatting via FormatCondition and enforce input constraints via Validation, both scoped to CellArea ranges.
capabilities.title: Support conditional formatting and validation

capabilities.text: Read and write core and extended metadata through WorkbookProperties and DocumentProperties exposed on Workbook.
capabilities.title: Access document properties

limitations.text: Only .xlsx (OOXML) format is supported for loading and saving; saving to other formats throws UnsupportedFeatureException.
Cell-level comments or notes are not modeled as a distinct object; only DefinedName includes a Comment field.
Some advanced conditional-formatting rule types are recognized on load but dropped with a WarningInfo diagnostic rather than preserved.
AutoFilter date-group filters using certain patterns are rejected as unsupported during load rather than approximated.

problems_solved.text: Enables programmatic Excel workbook manipulation in C++ without requiring Microsoft Excel or proprietary dependencies.
Provides a familiar API surface for developers experienced with Aspose.Cells commercial products, using Workbook, Worksheet, and Cell objects.
Supports cross-platform development on Windows, Linux, and macOS through a pure C++17 implementation with no external runtime dependencies.

product_summary.text: Aspose.Cells FOSS for C++ is a dependency-free, open-source C++17 library for creating, loading, editing, and saving Excel .xlsx workbooks without requiring Microsoft Excel.

uncertainties: The exact set of supported conditional-formatting rule types that are dropped with WarningInfo is not specified beyond 'some advanced' types.
The precise behavior of AutoFilter date-group filter rejection during load is not detailed beyond 'certain patterns'.

workflows.name: Create and save a new workbook
workflows.text: Instantiate a Workbook, access its WorksheetCollection, populate cells with values and formulas, apply styles, and save to an .xlsx file.

workflows.name: Load and read an existing workbook
workflows.text: Construct a Workbook from a file path or in-memory std::vector<std::uint8_t> stream, then access cells and extract values or formulas.

workflows.name: Apply formatting and conditional rules
workflows.text: Set cell styles including font, fill, borders, and alignment; add conditional formatting rules and data validation constraints.

workflows.name: Configure print and view settings
workflows.text: Adjust worksheet visibility, zoom, gridlines, headers, page setup, and protection options via Worksheet and PageSetup properties.
